# rubrik_gcp_kms_key_manager (Resource)

The `rubrik_gcp_kms_key_manager` resource is used to register a GCP Cloud KMS
key manager in RSC.

A key manager is a stored connection profile giving RSC access to a customer
owned key management service. RSC takes the credentials from the cloud account,
so no credentials are stored. Its ID is the value archival locations refer to
the key manager by, alongside the name and version of the key itself, which come
from GCP.

-> **Note:** The GCP project must be onboarded to RSC with the
   `CLOUD_NATIVE_UEM_KEY_MANAGEMENT` feature, and the feature must be connected.

-> **Note:** RSC only supports updating the `name` and the `description`.
   Changing any other argument replaces the key manager. RSC refuses to delete a
   key manager which still encrypts an archival location.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Register a GCP Cloud KMS key manager for a GCP project onboarded with the
# CLOUD_NATIVE_UEM_KEY_MANAGEMENT feature.
resource "rubrik_gcp_kms_key_manager" "production" {
  name             = "Production GCP KMS"
  description      = "Keys for the RCV archival locations."
  cloud_account_id = "f8c9c2a0-f02e-494d-bba9-0d4906917b8c"
  region           = "us-west1"
  key_ring         = "archive-key-ring"
}

# The key manager ID is the value an RCV archival location refers to it by.
resource "rubrik_gcp_rcv_archival_location" "archive" {
  name   = "us-west1-kms-archive"
  region = "us-west1"
  tier   = "BACKUP"

  kms_key {
    key_manager_id = rubrik_gcp_kms_key_manager.production.id
    key_name       = "archive-key"
    key_version    = "1"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud_account_id` (String) RSC cloud account ID of the GCP project holding the key ring. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
- `key_ring` (String) Short name of the Cloud KMS key ring, not the fully qualified resource path. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
- `name` (String) Key manager name. Key manager names are unique across all key managers.
- `region` (String) Cloud KMS location of the key ring, e.g. `us-west1`. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Key manager description.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) RSC key manager ID (UUID).
